# The browser block with browser-automation = true (this run's own config).
size:1280x800
wait:0.5
browser:open @SITE@/index.html ==> b1
page-wait:go
expect-tab:Probe Home
browser:url ==> /index.html
browser:title ==> Probe Home
browser:text ==> Home page
# Typing and clicking in the page.
browser:type #name Libertty ==>
browser:click #go ==>
browser:eval "document.getElementById('out').textContent" ==> Hello, Libertty
browser:click #nothing-here ==> !nothing matches
browser:text #out ==> Hello, Libertty
browser:html #out ==> <p id="out">
browser:type ==> !which element
browser:frobnicate ==> !unknown +browser command
# The page as roles and names, what can be acted on with a ref; acting by ref.
browser:snapshot ==> heading "Home page" [level=1]
browser:snapshot ==> link "Second page" [ref=e1] → second.html
browser:snapshot ==> button "Greet" [ref=e4]
browser:snapshot --interactive ==> textbox [ref=e3]
browser:type --ref e3 Ada ==>
browser:click --ref e4 ==>
browser:text #out ==> Hello, Ada
browser:snapshot ==> textbox [ref=e3]: "Ada"
browser:snapshot #out ==> paragraph "Hello, Ada"
# Links, history, a new-window link staying here; refs end with the page.
browser:click #next ==>
wait:0.8
expect-tab:Second
browser:click --ref e4 ==> !no e4 on this page
browser:back ==>
wait:0.8
expect-tab:Probe Home
browser:forward ==>
wait:0.8
expect-tab:Second
browser:back ==>
wait:0.8
browser:click #popup ==>
wait:0.8
expect-tab:Second
# The address bar: an address without its scheme, and back home.
bar:@HOST@/index.html
wait:0.8
expect-tab:Probe Home
browser:screenshot @OUT@/browser-shot.png ==> browser-shot.png
expect-shell:test -s @OUT@/browser-shot.png && echo yes ==> yes
shot:browser.png
# A page in a tab not in front, driven by its ID (b2 is the popup's tab): nothing comes forward.
browser:open --no-focus @SITE@/app.html ==> b3
wait:1.5
expect-page:Home page
expect-page-not:Form page
browser:list ==> b3  @SITE@/app.html
browser:wait --pane b3 --load ==>
browser:title --pane b3 ==> Probe App
browser:snapshot --pane b3 ==> textbox "Your name"
browser:snapshot --pane b3 ==> checkbox "I agree"
browser:snapshot --pane b3 ==> combobox "Color" [ref=
browser:snapshot --pane b3 ==> option "Green"
browser:snapshot --pane b3 ==> navigation "Main"
browser:type --pane b3 #who Ada ==>
browser:check --pane b3 #agree ==>
browser:select --pane b3 #color Green ==> g
browser:select --pane b3 #color Purple ==> !no option "Purple"
browser:type --pane b3 #notes one ==>
browser:press --pane b3 Enter #notes ==>
browser:type --pane b3 #notes two --append ==>
browser:press --pane b3 Enter #who ==>
browser:text --pane b3 #status ==> sent Ada agree=true color=g notes=one|two input=trusted
browser:uncheck --pane b3 #agree ==>
browser:eval --pane b3 "String(document.getElementById('agree').checked)" ==> false
expect-page:Home page
browser:snapshot --pane b3 #f ==> checkbox "I agree" [ref=
browser:snapshot --pane b3 #f ==> combobox "Color" [ref=e
browser:click --pane b3 #card ==>
browser:text --pane b3 #status ==> card pointerdown,mousedown,pointerup,mouseup at its middle
browser:snapshot --pane b3 --interactive ==> clickable "Open the card" [ref=
# Key by key, for a page that listens to keys; what the field held goes first.
browser:type --pane b3 #search old ==>
browser:type --pane b3 #search "a B" --keys ==>
browser:text --pane b3 #status ==> keyup a B after a B
browser:type --pane b3 #search " c" --append ==>
browser:eval --pane b3 "document.getElementById('search').value" ==> a B c
browser:type --pane b3 #search "" --append ==>
browser:eval --pane b3 "document.getElementById('search').value" ==> a B c
# A number field's value is replaced, not added to.
browser:type --pane b3 #qty 7 ==>
browser:eval --pane b3 "document.getElementById('qty').value + '!'" ==> 7!
# Waiting: for what a page shows later, what goes, where it is.
browser:click --pane b3 #later ==>
browser:wait --pane b3 #late --timeout 0.1 ==> !waited 0.1 s: nothing shown matches #late
browser:wait --pane b3 #late ==>
browser:wait --pane b3 --text "Here at last" ==>
browser:wait --pane b3 --url *app.html ==>
browser:wait --pane b3 #nothing --gone --timeout 1 ==>
browser:wait --pane b3 "#[" ==> !not a CSS selector
# What a dialog covers isn't clicked through it (unless forced); keys reach the page.
browser:click --pane b3 #cover ==>
browser:click --pane b3 #under ==> !is covered by <div#overlay>
browser:click --pane b3 #under --force ==>
browser:text --pane b3 #status ==> under clicked
browser:press --pane b3 Escape ==>
browser:text --pane b3 #status ==> escaped 27
browser:press --pane b3 hyper+q ==> !not a key
# Cookies: saved (this user's only), cleared, loaded back. This host's only: the store is every probe's.
browser:cookies --pane b3 clear --domain 127.0.0.1 ==> cleared
browser:reload --pane b3 ==>
wait:0.8
browser:wait --pane b3 --load ==>
browser:cookies --pane b3 save @OUT@/browser-cookies.json --domain 127.0.0.1 ==> 1 cookie saved to
expect-shell:grep -c '"name": "probe' @OUT@/browser-cookies.json ==> 1
expect-shell:stat -f %Lp @OUT@/browser-cookies.json ==> 600
browser:cookies --pane b3 clear --domain 127.0.0.1 ==> 1 cookie cleared
browser:eval --pane b3 "document.cookie.includes('=kept') ? 'still' : 'gone'" ==> gone
browser:cookies --pane b3 load @OUT@/browser-cookies.json ==> 1 cookie loaded
browser:eval --pane b3 "document.cookie.includes('=kept') ? 'still' : 'gone'" ==> still
browser:cookies --pane b3 load @OUT@/nothing-here.json ==> !can't read
# A picture of the page no one sees.
browser:screenshot --pane b3 @OUT@/browser-hidden.png ==> browser-hidden.png
expect-shell:test -s @OUT@/browser-hidden.png && echo yes ==> yes
browser:click --pane b9 #x ==> !no browser or session b9
# From a terminal, as an agent would: the page beside it is the one meant; the keyboard stays.
tab:1
wait:0.5
type:libertty +browser open --split --no-focus @SITE@/second.html; echo "OPENED=$?"
key:enter
wait:2
expect:OPENED=0
expect-panes:2
expect-focus:1
type:T=$(libertty +browser title); echo "TITLE=$T"
key:enter
wait:1
expect:TITLE=Second
type:echo "BESIDE=$(libertty +browser list | grep -c 'second.html.*tab 1 beside .*[*]$')"
key:enter
wait:1
expect:BESIDE=1
type:libertty +browser wait '#nope' --timeout 0.2; echo "WAITED=$?"
key:enter
wait:1.5
expect:WAITED=124
type:libertty +browser click; echo "USAGE=$?"
key:enter
wait:1
expect:USAGE=2
